Note: This parameter is only used in case th e parameter Type is set to TCPIP_ IPADDR_ ASSIGNMENT_ STATIC, can be set to NULL_ PTR otherwise. Default Router Ptr Pointer to structure containing the IP addre ss of the default router (gateway) which shall be assigned. Note: This parameter is only used in case the parameter Type is set to TCPIP_ IPADDR_ ASSIGNMENT_ STATIC, can be set to NULL_ PTR otherwise. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The request has been accepted E_ NOT_ OK: The request has not been accepted Description By this API service the local IP address assignment which shall be used for the socket connection specified by So Con Id is initiated. Available via So Ad.h
